channel.title: Vishal Tyagi
channel.description: Engineering projects, case studies, and notes from Vishal Tyagi.

item.title: Comparing Event-Deduplication Strategies for Client-Side Analytics
item.description: An open investigation into time-windowed vs. idempotency-key deduplication for client-emitted analytics events, prompted by dedup work on the product analytics layer.

item.title: Modeling 'Either, Or, Both' States Without a Combinatorial Explosion
item.description: An open look at how the gsmNCloud three-state model from the hybrid telephony work generalizes to other 'a user can have A, B, or both' product situations.

item.title: Designing an Event Taxonomy for Amplitude
item.description: How to name events and properties so analytics stays usable as the product grows, instead of becoming hundreds of one-off strings.

item.title: Docker for Local Development: A Practical Workflow
item.description: A docker-compose setup for local dev that stays fast — bind mounts, layer caching, and the tradeoffs that actually matter day to day.

item.title: Setting Up a Flutter Development Environment on Linux
item.description: A practical setup for Flutter + Dart on Linux — SDK install, editor config, emulator, and the gotchas that waste the first hour.

item.title: Product Analytics Pipeline
item.description: Built a product analytics telemetry pipeline : a provider abstraction over Amplitude, typed event schemas, Hive-backed client buffering, and sliding-window deduplication.

item.title: Behavioral Event Pipeline Design
item.description: Case study of the ProductAnalytics pipeline: environment isolation, sliding-window deduplication, and Hive-backed buffering for high-frequency CRM activity.

item.title: Sizing an event deduplication window
item.description: A short note on why a fixed time window for analytics event deduplication needs tuning, not just existing.

item.title: Make analytics events boring on purpose
item.description: The unsexy taxonomy rules that keep Amplitude usable after the third redesign — and why exciting event names are usually a future outage.

item.title: Turning scattered product behavior into systems
item.description: A recurring theme in product engineering: ambiguous, duplicated behavior across screens is more dangerous than it looks, and the fix is rarely glamorous.

item.title: Hybrid Telephony Workflows
item.description: Built a unified multi-channel communication state machine so operators can move between cloud virtual numbers and cellular calling inside one session — without tearing down auth, caches, or sync queues.

item.title: Single-Session Multi-Channel Calling
item.description: How the hybrid telephony work moved channel selection out of session init — enum state, session-preserving driver swaps, and callMedium attribution across logs and analytics.

item.title: Keeping sandbox traffic out of production analytics
item.description: Why analytics initialization should check environment/host before sending any events, not just before reporting them.

item.title: Admin Web Migration
item.description: Migrated the administrative web surface incrementally while ops kept working — shared sheet validation, multi-step upload wizards, and dirty-check wrappers replaced duplicated legacy UI plumbing.

item.title: Incremental Admin UI Migration
item.description: Case study of migrating the Flutter web admin tooling without a big-bang outage — client-side sheet validation, reusable wizards, and dirty-check navigation guards.

item.title: Manufacturing Inventory Platform Rebuild
item.description: Rebuilt The manufacturing client's inventory tooling from a rigid monolith to Flutter clients over Express/MongoDB, with Node-RED/OPC UA bridging Siemens and Delta PLC telemetry into the same operational picture.

item.title: PostgREST + RLS for Multi-Tenant APIs
item.description: How PostgREST plus PostgreSQL Row Level Security removes a class of CRUD controllers — tenants are isolated in the database, and a thin backend only handles auth, uploads, and side effects.

item.title: Plugin-Style ETL on AWS Lambda
item.description: Serverless ETL where sources, transforms, and sinks are plugins loaded from a YAML job config — deployed on Lambda via Serverless Framework without a heavy orchestration layer for single-step jobs.

item.title: School CMS on Shared Hosting
item.description: Production school CMS — Laravel 11 and Filament v3 with RBAC, galleries, announcements, webhook auto-deploy, and php-ghost-wall integrity checks on shared hosting.

item.title: Shared hosting is a product constraint, not an insult
item.description: You don't always get systemd. Here's how to still ship queues, webhook deploys, and integrity checks — and when to stop pretending shared hosting is fine.

item.title: Webhook Deploys Without CI/CD
item.description: Automatic git-pull deployments on shared hosting: GitHub webhook → Laravel endpoint → queued RunDeployment job, and when that pattern is (and is not) appropriate.

item.title: RAG over PDFs with LlamaIndex
item.description: How a PDF chatbot grounds answers with VectorStoreIndex — chunking, retrieval, generation — and why a global in-memory index is a demo ceiling, not a product architecture.

item.title: Face Validation API Prototype
item.description: Prototype Express API exploring server-side face detection with face-api.js / TensorFlow.js — auth and middleware are solid; the detection route is intentionally unfinished and documented as such.

item.title: Laravel Queue Worker on Shared Hosting
item.description: A small Node.js process manager that spawns and restarts Laravel's queue worker on shared hosting where Supervisor/systemd are unavailable.

item.title: PHP Ghost Wall
item.description: Composer package for Laravel that hash-checks a monitored file on every boot, POSTs a tamper alert if it changed, and phones home with server metadata — built for shared hosting without CI file watchers.

item.title: Smart Irrigation IoT
item.description: Built a soil/climate irrigation setup: NodeMCU sensors publish to Firebase, a Flutter dashboard visualizes the stream, and an SVM model drives pump actuation with hard edge cutoffs if the cloud path stalls.

item.title: Boot-Time Code Integrity in Laravel
item.description: SHA-256 hash-check a critical file on every Laravel boot and webhook a tamper alert — when the pattern helps on shared hosting, and the SSL/single-file limits to fix before you trust it.

item.title: Hash-Check a Laravel File on Every Boot
item.description: Add a ServiceProvider that SHA-256 checks a critical file, webhooks on mismatch, and heartbeats on success — a shared-hosting substitute for OS-level FIM.

item.title: Keep Laravel Queues Alive on Shared Hosting
item.description: Build a tiny Node.js supervisor that restarts php artisan queue:work when your host won't give you systemd — then prove it with a log you can open in the browser.

item.title: Floor Plan Builder — Flutter Package
item.description: Flutter package for rendering interactive restaurant/venue floor plans from a JSON table list — shapes, availability colors, pinch-to-zoom, and onTableTap callbacks.

item.title: image_hotspot — Flutter Package
item.description: Published a Flutter package for defining interactive, clickable hotspot areas on images — useful for floor plans, diagrams, and annotated photos.

item.title: Real-time Location Tracker
item.description: Browser GPS sharing over Socket.IO: every connected client broadcasts coordinates; a shared Leaflet map shows live markers with device popups and auto-fit bounds.

item.title: Extract the package while the app is still shipping
item.description: image_hotspot and floor_plan_builder exist because a restaurant layout needed tap regions — and a second app was about to copy-paste them. Extraction timing beats perfection.

item.title: Live GPS Map with Socket.IO and Leaflet
item.description: Build a multi-user location board in one sitting — Express broadcasts coordinates, Leaflet draws markers, disconnects clean themselves up.

item.title: Campus Exam Portal
item.description: Built Campus Quest, a campus examination portal with per-session question/option permutation, focus-loss integrity signals, and bulk question-bank ingestion for faculty.

item.title: OMR Sheet Automation
item.description: Built a staged, fault-tolerant Python OMR pipeline that processed over 90,000 physical examination forms.

item.title: Blockchain NGO Donation Tracking
item.description: Built an Ethereum-based donation tracking prototype at a nonprofit: lifecycle states on-chain, receipt hashes for auditability, MetaMask-signed attestations — without the platform holding custodial keys.

item.title: RAG Document Chatbot
item.description: Retrieval-augmented chatbot over PDF docs: embed with a hosted model, retrieve top chunks, answer with an LLM constrained to that context — Flask UI, honest notes on global-index limits.

item.title: E-commerce Price & Catalog Sync
item.description: Automated supplier catalog extraction and price-drift detection for an electronics e-commerce store — margin rules and outlier thresholds produce OpenCart import manifests instead of manual daily price checks.

item.title: HTML Content Translator
item.description: Python utility that walks an HTML DOM with BeautifulSoup, translates visible text nodes (EN→HI), and leaves tags, attributes, and script/style alone.

item.title: Translate HTML without breaking the DOM
item.description: A short, copy-pasteable pattern: BeautifulSoup text-node walks for markup-safe transforms — translation today, anything that touches visible text tomorrow.

item.title: No-Code ML Environment
item.description: Flask app that wraps common supervised-learning pipelines behind a UI: CSV upload, column picker, sklearn regressors or Keras LSTM, then MAE/MSE/RMSE plus a prediction plot.

item.title: Schema-Driven School CRUD GUI
item.description: Class-project desktop GUI that introspects SQLite at runtime and generates navigation, CRUD forms, and tables dynamically — closer to a tiny low-code engine than hand-built screens.
